about: REE-265 step 0: the ceilings of the work one answer may make, per state (tools/answercost.js, tests/answercost.test.js), for a player in the middle of a session (the page's clock 30 s after the state's last answer), signed out. Each is the largest count measured on main after #1522 over the page's seeds 1 to 3 and one regeneration of the state (the same state and seed give counts that differ by up to 15% from run to run, the seeds by up to 50% on fish:3000), times the margin, rounded up to two significant digits, at least 100 calls. A step that lowers a count tightens its ceilings in the same PR: node tools/answercost.js --write-budget tools/answercost-budget.json --margin 1.1 --also <the --out files of other seeds>.
